mechanisms.note: evaluated only every update_every_labeled labels; the recent window retains at most recent_capacity labels
needs a defect-sparse recent window AND a current FPR above the trigger; an observed-rate condition that a budget count alone can never guarantee
disabled by default; additionally needs the FPR trigger, which no budget count guarantees
disabled by default; the per-label fast trigger can fire earlier (2 verified FP normals or 1 verified FN defect) but the guarded objective still needs both anchor groups

declared_threshold_roles.min_normal_anchor: selects the robust quantile branch of _candidate_thetas; the fallback branch computes the same quantile whenever bufN > 0, so this value does not by itself gate activation
declared_threshold_roles.min_defect_anchor: same as above for bufA: it selects a branch, not a gate, in the current implementation
declared_threshold_roles.min_recent_total: hard gate on the recent labelled window
declared_threshold_roles.min_recent_per_class: hard gate on both label classes in the window

claim_boundary: crossing a global anchor-count threshold does not guarantee activation
crossing min_normal_anchor or min_defect_anchor is not sufficient
actual activation requires executing the online controller
no Sidecar threshold was lowered to make a budget look feasible

Q-A.contract: one pre-registered label-blind random tape per class/stream/seed/budget, replayed unchanged to every Admission method

allowed_inputs: sanitized PublicObservation: opaque handle, camera id, step and phase
frozen reference scorer output for the current image
the reference controller's own previously disclosed labels and spent budget
shared initial theta0 and pre-registered rule constants
forbidden_inputs: STM/LTM/Buffer contents of any compared Admission method
Signed Correction or dynamic Sidecar state of any method
future labels, evaluation-probe labels, defect masks
label-conditional stratification of the query tape
raw Real-IAD path / official sample key containing OK or NG tokens
Q-B.output_contract: one frozen query tape replayed unchanged to every Admission method
Q-B.budget_rule: cap B; unused budget is saved and reported, never backfilled with future labels

allowed_inputs: each method's own legal online state (memory, correction, sidecar)
labels that method has itself already obtained
its own remaining budget under the shared cap B
forbidden_inputs: future labels, evaluation-probe labels, defect masks
another method's query ledger or memory state
Q-C.output_contract: per-method query trajectory allowed; shared budget cap and identical supervision permissions
Q-C.reporting_rule: call it budget-cap-matched, not count-matched, whenever actual label counts differ

claim_boundaries: no Admission algorithm is implemented in D1-A
Q-B and Q-C are declared interfaces only
an exceeded anchor count does not establish Sidecar activation
budget feasibility is a metadata statement, not a performance claim
